name: com.opportunv.live-cursor
description: Animated hardware (OS) cursors with zero added input lag. Looping cursor states, authored transitions that play in reverse and turn around mid-way, per-state click points, and a builder that turns a folder of frames into a cursor set.

samples.description: Two cursor skins with eight states, a UI Toolkit scene, and a uGUI and 3D scene (needs the uGUI package).
